summary: Verified Dashboard.js Parker cleanup (1047 -> 232 lines) and PresupuestoEditable.js placeholder removal (519 -> 514 lines) live on preview with admin earauzt@gmail.com. All 9 acceptance criteria PASS. The Network panel verification confirms only the expected 2 API endpoints are called on Dashboard load (down from 12). No regressions found across /movimientos, /deudas, /fiscal, /viajes.

issues: Cosmetic micro-spacing carryover from iter31: '+$8,88·$2.598,77gastos' renders without spaces around the '·' separator and before 'gastos'. Not blocking. Same issue reported in iteration_31.

dashboard_network_minimal.details: Captured all /api/* requests via page.on('request') during /dashboard load. Unique endpoints called: ['/auth/me', '/dashboard/stats', '/transactions']. /auth/me is from layout/AuthContext (expected). The Dashboard itself ONLY hit /api/dashboard/stats?period=month and /api/transactions?limit=5000. Confirmed ZERO calls to: /reminders, /cashflow/projection, /travel-goals, /travel-fund, /sri/counters, /sri/deduction-limits, /notificaciones, /dashboard/esta-semana, /dashboard/subscription-renewals, /dashboard/chart-data. Reduction 12 -> 2 verified.

dashboard_section2_categories_list.details: categories-list-card present with header '8 categorías · $1.288,67 total'. Exactly 8 category-row-<key> entries rendered (max=8 satisfied). Sorted DESC by value: Comida $552,32 (43%) > Gastos Libres (Otros) $294,61 (23%) > Servicios Básicos $261,60 (20%) > Carros $111,64 (9%) > Restaurantes $68,50 (5%) > Empleados $0,00 > Colegio y Actividades $0,00 > Seguros $0,00 (0-value rows kept because budget>0 — matches code filter d.value>0||d.budget>0). Progress bars contain class 'bg-[#0D9E82]' uniformly (verified via card.innerHTML.includes('#0D9E82') = true).

dashboard_section3_por_revisar.details: por-revisar-card visible (admin has 4 pending). por-revisar-count text = '4 movimientos por revisar'. Card is clickable and routes to /movimientos?tab=por-revisar via navigate().

dashboard_period_selector.details: period-select trigger opens. Selecting 'Esta semana' triggers exactly 1 fresh request to /api/dashboard/stats?period=week (verified via request listener). Switching back to 'Este mes' re-fetches with period=month.

presupuesto_placeholder_removed.details: /mi-dinero?tab=presupuesto loads cleanly (no errors). Confirmed in source PresupuestoEditable.js lines 247-251: Card closes -> comment '{/* Hidden sections (replaced by the simplified summary above) */}' -> '{/* Tabs */}' -> Tabs JSX. Empty hidden Card placeholder is GONE from JSX. Legacy 'Resumen Mensual' text NOT present in DOM. The 3 elements with [hidden] attr in DOM are Radix UI inactive TabsContent panels (normal Radix behavior, not the removed placeholder).

regression_movimientos_trash.details: /movimientos?tab=todos shows 100 standalone delete-approved-* Trash buttons (one per approved tx). No regression.

regression_deudas.details: /deudas loads with summary metrics (Deuda Total $31.999,83, Crédito Disponible $-14.299,83, Utilización shown). Multiple cards render (17 .bento-card or [data-testid*='card']). No errors.

regression_fiscal.details: /fiscal loads with tabs (Facturas, Deducciones, Resumen) and 'Mis Facturas' content. No errors.

regression_viajes.details: /viajes loads cleanly with Meta Anual 2026, Ya Ahorrado $2.726,50, Gastado $44,74, Disponible $2.681,76. Destinos tab shows 4 viaje cards (Navidad, Entretenimiento, Test Destination 24c1, Test Destination 3630). No errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js (232 lines): clean, focused, no dead imports or unused state remaining. Excellent cleanup — reduces bundle and cognitive load. The conditional render via IIFE for Sección 2 is fine for keeping totalSpent/rows local. Consider extracting if it grows.

Dashboard.js: the income/expenses line uses 'mx-2 text-slate-300' on the '·' separator which CAN render tightly when the surrounding spans contain right-trimmed currency strings. Verify by adding non-breaking spaces or wider spacing (e.g., px-1) to render '+$8,88 · $2.598,77 gastos' visually clean on all widths. Same issue noted in iter31.

PresupuestoEditable.js (514 lines): placeholder Card fully removed, Tabs now flow naturally after the new summary Card. Clean. File still ~514 lines — could be split into PresupuestoSummary + PresupuestoTabs sub-components if it grows further.

Dashboard.js: the 0-value categories (Empleados, Colegio, Seguros) appear with empty Progress bars and '$0,00 / 0%'. This is technically correct per the d.budget>0 filter but consumes 3 of the 8 row slots. Consider showing only categories with value>0 in Sección 2 (the budget-only categories already appear in /mi-dinero?tab=presupuesto). UX call for main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard.js Parker cleanup (1047 -> 232 lines, 78% reduction) is verified working. Confirmed via Playwright page.on('request') that Dashboard now ONLY calls /api/dashboard/stats and /api/transactions (plus /auth/me from layout). No forbidden endpoint calls. All 3 sections render correctly with proper data-testid. PresupuestoEditable.js placeholder Card removed cleanly. No regressions on /movimientos /deudas /fiscal /viajes. Only carry-over cosmetic issue: income/expenses line spacing around '·' separator — same as iter31, non-blocking.
